summary: Iter15 RETEST of the iter14 per-customer prefs action items. All 6 items are verified fixed. Backend: 18/18 new pytest pass, and the iter14 suite passes 17/17 (test_dot_decimal_price now passes; the one first-run failure of test_get_default came from my own UI-test prefs on 227470352 and passed on rerun). Frontend: /pay plan-conflict warning and disabled checkout, the blocked-login full-price total with an injected 10% discount, and CustomerPrefsDialog save/close/reopen/switch with no crash all verified. No real payments, WhatsApp messages or renewals. Prefs and temp payments were cleaned up.

minor.issue: A single-dot thousands value like '1.025' (meaning R$1.025) is read as R$1,03 (103 cents) and accepted. A JSON bool true is an int and is stored as 1 cent. Both are low risk because the UI always sends a comma decimal.

issues: Plan picker is a native <select> (styled dark), not a shadcn Select. Cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: parse_brl: '25,50' / '25.50' / 'R$ 1.025,50' map to 2550 / 2550 / 102550. 0, negative, >R$10.000 and 'abc' return 400. R$10.000,00 exactly is accepted.
auto_coupon.sweep_once skips discount_blocked users before the idempotency marker and before coupon creation (verified with a mocked sweep: only the unblocked user was sent).
upcoming._plan_for filters notify_events and drops auto_recovery_coupon when no_discount. Verified both in unit tests and through GET /api/painel/users/{id}/notifications.

create_payment extras: e_fixed mismatch returns 400 'Um dos logins selecionados só pode renovar em outro plano'. A matching plan is accepted (3m main + 3m extra = 18000). With a 10% discount, a blocked extra pays full price (2700+3000+2700 = 8400).
